adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces an authenticated `addGuests` mutation whose input schema `ZAddGuestsInputSchema` is `guests: z.array(z.string().email())` with no `.min(1)` or `.max(...)` cap (packages/trpc/.../addGuests.schema.ts). The handler then `createMany` inserts one attendee row per provided email (addGuests.handler.ts: `attendees.createMany` from `uniqueGuests`) and then builds `evt.attendees` from *all* booking attendees and calls `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` which maps over `calendarEvent.attendees` and sends an email per attendee plus organizer/team copies (packages/emails/email-manager.ts). There is no bound anywhere in this path, so a large array (e.g., 10k) would pass validation and trigger unbounded DB writes and email fan-out, and subsequent calls increase `calendarEvent.attendees` size, compounding the loop cost.
